objective: Run all E2E gates (E1-E5) and acceptance criteria (A1-A5) end-to-end: write tests/test_e2e_pdf.py with the five E2E scenarios, run the full test suite (existing + new), and record pass/fail evidence for each acceptance criterion in the checkpoint

concepts: acceptance criteria A1-A5 from stage contract

frozen_contracts.spec: JobStore interface: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id (str); get(job_id) -> Job | None where Job = {id, customer_id, report_id, lang, status: pending|running|done|failed, result: bytes|None, error: str|None, created_at: str}. Status transitions: pending->running (worker picks up), running->done (PDF generated), running->failed (exception). No other transitions allowed.

PdfExportService interface: export_pdf(customer_id: str, report_id: str, lang: str) -> bytes. Fetches report data via app/queries.report_with_rows (never reads _REPORTS directly). Uses pdflib_shim to render one page per report. Returns raw PDF bytes. Raises PdfExportError on failure. lang must be 'en' or 'de'; unknown lang raises ValueError.

POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf: body {lang: str (optional, default 'en')} -> 202 {job_id: str}. 404 if report_id unknown. 400 if lang not in {en, de}. GET /jobs/{id} -> 200 {job_id, status, result_available: bool, error: str|None}. 404 if job unknown. GET /jobs/{id}/download -> 200 (application/pdf bytes) if done, 409 if not done, 404 if unknown.

allowed_dependencies.what: Seam integration fixes (must be applied before E2E)

non_goals: Do not modify any source files outside tests/test_e2e_pdf.py
Do not add new endpoints or features
Do not run benchmarks or performance tests
implementation_constraints: E2E tests must use real implementations (no mocks for JobStore or PdfExportService)
Test the full flow: POST -> poll (with timeout) -> download
Each E2E gate (E1-E5) must be a separate test method
Run the full test suite: pytest tests/ (all existing + new tests)
Record pass/fail for each acceptance criterion A1-A5 in the checkpoint

deliverables.what: E2E test file with 5 test methods (E1-E5)
Final acceptance checkpoint with A1-A5 evidence

acceptance_tests.description: E1: Full export flow — POST /reports/r1/export-pdf -> 202, poll GET /jobs/{id} -> done, GET /jobs/{id}/download -> PDF bytes starting with %PDF
E3: POST /reports/r1/export-pdf with lang=fr -> 400 with error field
E4: GET /jobs/{id}/download while job is pending -> 409
E5: PdfExportService raises -> job status failed with error populated
A5: All existing CSV export tests remain green

failure_cases.scenario: Job never transitions to done (worker stuck)
failure_cases.expected_behavior: Test times out after 10 seconds and fails with assertion on job status

failure_cases.scenario: PDF bytes are empty or malformed
failure_cases.expected_behavior: Assertion fails: bytes must start with %PDF and be non-empty

handoff.notes: This is the final task. The checkpoint must include: (1) all E2E test results, (2) pass/fail for each acceptance criterion A1-A5, (3) full test suite result, (4) any deviations from the plan.
